target.title: fix(proxy-capture): honor response backpressure and client abort
target.body:
Closes #105701

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the debug proxy capture server would forward upstream response bodies without honoring `ServerResponse.write()` backpressure, and could crash or leave work running when a client aborted mid-stream. Operators and test fixtures using the debug proxy could see unbounded memory growth under slow clients and unhandled write errors on disconnect.

## Why This Change Was Made

The HTTP response forward path now uses one lifecycle controller (`pipeUpstreamBodyToClient`): pause the upstream readable when `write()` returns false and resume on `drain`, cancel upstream when the client leaves early, and keep body-preview capture independent of socket write success. Existing partial-upstream-error behavior (complete 502 before headers / abort after headers) is preserved.

## User Impact

Debug proxy traffic capture remains available for local diagnostics and fixture recording, but slow clients no longer force unbounded buffering of upstream response data, and mid-response client aborts no longer leave the proxy in a fragile write-after-end state. No product config or user-facing channel behavior changes.

## Evidence

Verification host: local macOS (Crabbox bypass)

Commands run:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/proxy-capture/proxy-server.test.ts
# 9/9 passed (including new backpressure + client-abort cases)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/proxy-capture/proxy-server.managed-proxy.test.ts
# 7/7 passed (sibling surface)

pnpm exec oxfmt --check -- src/proxy-capture/proxy-server.ts src/proxy-capture/proxy-server.test.ts
# pass

git diff --check -- src/proxy-capture/proxy-server.ts src/proxy-capture/proxy-server.test.ts
# pass
```

Closeout note: `pnpm check:changed` completed format + guards + core typecheck lanes; core-test typecheck was still running past ~45m with high CPU under the 1h closeout phase budget, so that step was stopped and replaced with path-scoped format/`git diff --check` plus the focused Vitest paths above.

Focused test names covering the fix:

- `pipeUpstreamBodyToClient` pauses the upstream source when `write()` applies backpressure and resumes on drain
- `pipeUpstreamBodyToClient` destroys the upstream source when the client leaves before end
- `startDebugProxyServer` survives a mid-response client abort and still serves later requests
- Existing UTF-8 preview, pre-header 502, and post-header abort cases still pass

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: Debug proxy HTTP response forwarding honors write backpressure (pause/drain) and cancels upstream when the client aborts mid-response, without losing capture-preview callbacks or breaking later requests.
- Environment: local macOS, OpenClaw checkout at commit after this patch, Node via `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs`.
- Current-main contrast: On main, `upstreamRes.on("data")` always called `res.write(buffer)` with no pause on false, and client close did not cancel the upstream body reader—slow clients could buffer unboundedly and mid-stream aborts could surface write-after-end failures.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:
  1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/proxy-capture/proxy-server.test.ts`
  2. Observed unit harness: FakeDownstream returns `write() === false` once → FakeUpstream pauses until `drain`, then resumes and completes.
  3. Integration: streaming origin + client destroy after first chunk → later `/healthy` through the same proxy still returns 200 `ok`.
- Evidence after fix:
  ```text
  ✓ |unit-fast| src/proxy-capture/proxy-server.test.ts (9 tests) 1204ms
    ✓ pauses the upstream source when write() applies backpressure and resumes on drain
    ✓ destroys the upstream source when the client leaves before end
    ✓ survives a mid-response client abort and still serves later requests  303ms
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  9 passed (9)
  ```
- Control check: Existing preview truncation and upstream-error cases still pass in the same file; managed-proxy sibling suite (7 tests) still passes, showing the change is isolated to the HTTP body forwarder.
- Observed result after fix: Backpressure false → pause; drain → resume; client close → upstream destroyed; subsequent requests succeed.
- What was not tested: Live CONNECT tunnel backpressure (still uses socket `pipe`), production load with multi-GB responses, non-macOS hosts, and full-repo `pnpm check` / core-test typecheck completion under the closeout time budget.

## AI disclosure

This fix was authored with AI assistance (Grok). Human operator owns the contributor fork push and PR submission policy for this pipeline.
